gloss: to approach; to come to; to reach (a point)

definitions.gloss: to approach; to come to; to reach
definitions.explanation: To arrive at or reach a particular point, location, or stage.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}に{差|さ}し{掛|か}かったところで{電話|でんわ}が{鳴|な}った。
examples.english: The phone rang just as I was approaching the station.

examples.japanese: {話|はなし}がクライマックスに{差|さ}し{掛|か}かる。
examples.english: The story is approaching its climax.

examples.japanese: {橋|はし}に{差|さ}し{掛|か}かると、{美|うつく}しい{景色|けしき}が{見|み}えた。
examples.english: When we came to the bridge, a beautiful view opened up.

examples.japanese: {試合|しあい}は{終盤|しゅうばん}に{差|さ}し{掛|か}かっている。
examples.english: The match is approaching its final stage.

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}り{始|はじ}めたのは、ちょうど{山|やま}の{頂上|ちょうじょう}に{差|さ}し{掛|か}かったときだった。
examples.english: It started raining just as we were approaching the mountain summit.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{差|さ}し{掛|か}かる → {差|さ}し{掛|か}からない (negative)
・{差|さ}し{掛|か}かる → {差|さ}し{掛|か}かって (te-form)
・{差|さ}し{掛|か}かる → {差|さ}し{掛|か}かった (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {差|さ}す (to extend) + {掛|か}かる (to hang over, to be about to)

USAGE:
・〜に{差|さ}し{掛|か}かる (to approach/reach ~)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{山場|やまば}に{差|さ}し{掛|か}かる (to reach a critical point)
・{終盤|しゅうばん}に{差|さ}し{掛|か}かる (to approach the final stage)
・{坂|さか}に{差|さ}し{掛|か}かる (to come to a hill)
・{中年|ちゅうねん}に{差|さ}し{掛|か}かる (to approach middle age)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{近|ちか}づく - to approach (more general)
